req.title: Unsupported methods rejected
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 405 when using an unsupported method against /tasks/{task_id}.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates HTTP 405 for unsupported HTTP methods on /tasks/{task_id}. Supported methods are GET, PUT, DELETE. Unsupported methods include POST, PATCH, HEAD (as a data method), OPTIONS (framework-dependent), TRACE, etc. Tests cover: (1) positive — a supported method (GET) returns 2xx to confirm the endpoint is live and routing works; (2) negative — POST to /tasks/{task_id} returns exactly 405; (3) boundary — multiple unsupported methods (PATCH, TRACE) each return exactly 405, exercising the method-check boundary between allowed and disallowed. Exact status code assertions (== 405, == 200) are used throughout to catch constant-mutation operators. Both sides of the allowed/disallowed boundary are tested.

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_existing_task_returns_200():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r = client.get("/tasks/1")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body["id"] == 1
    assert body["title"] == "Read chapter 5"
    assert body["completed"] == True

tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_boundary_supported_vs_unsupported_methods_on_same_task():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r_get = client.get("/tasks/3")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    assert r_get.json()["id"] == 3
    update_body = {"title": "Submit expense report", "completed": True}
    r_put = client.put("/tasks/3", json=update_body)
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/3", json={"title": "X", "completed": False})
    assert r_post.status_code == 405
    r_patch = client.patch("/tasks/3", json={"completed": False})
    assert r_patch.status_code == 405
    r_del = client.delete("/tasks/3")
    assert r_del.status_code == 204

test_boundary_supported_vs_unsupported_methods_on_same_task()

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_post_to_nonexistent_task_id_returns_405_not_404():
    client = TestClient(app)
    payload = {"title": "Ghost Task", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/9999", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 405
    assert r.status_code != 404
    assert r.status_code != 200
    assert r.status_code != 422

from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_put_supported_and_post_unsupported_exact_status_codes():
    client = TestClient(app)
    put_body = {"title": "Write project report", "completed": False}
    r_put = client.put("/tasks/5", json=put_body)
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    assert r_put.status_code != 201
    assert r_put.status_code != 204
    assert r_put.status_code != 405
    r_post = client.post("/tasks/5", json={"title": "Write project report", "completed": False})
    assert r_post.status_code == 405
    assert r_post.status_code != 404
    assert r_post.status_code != 400
    assert r_post.status_code != 200

test_put_supported_and_post_unsupported_exact_status_codes()
